S43.01.needs: a signed-in account, a photo file
S43.01.note: In Local mode the app only reads text from the photo on the device (chatExecutionStore: 'cannot inspect the image pixels directly'), so test in Cloud. The owner's live check of the upload scanner (UPLOAD_SCAN_WEBHOOK_URL) is still pending.
steps: Sign in and make sure the mode control shows Cloud selected.
Tap Add to chat (the + button beside the message box).
Tap Photos and pick one photo.
Tap Message input, type 'What is in this photo?' and tap Send message.
Check that the reply describes the photo, as Expected says.
S43.01.where: Chat screen > Add to chat > Photos

S43.02.needs: a signed-in account, two photo files
S43.02.note: The number of photos allowed per message depends on the plan (photoSelectionLimitForPlan); the 'up to 4 photos' cap in the sheet applies to image creation, not chat. Owner's live check of the upload scanner is still pending.
steps: Tap Add to chat, then Photos.
Select two photos in the picker (it allows several, in order).
Type 'Compare these two images: what is different?' in Message input and tap Send message.
Check that the reply compares both photos, as Expected says.
S43.02.where: Chat screen > Add to chat > Photos

S43.03.note: 'Paste image' is hidden unless the clipboard has an image. Captured screenshots can also be attached with Photos.
steps: Take a screenshot on the device and copy it to the clipboard.
Tap Add to chat, then Paste image (this row only shows when the clipboard holds an image).
Type 'What does this screenshot show?' in Message input and tap Send message.
Check that the reply explains the screenshot, as Expected says.
S43.03.where: Chat screen > Add to chat > Paste image (or Photos for a saved screenshot)

S43.04.needs: a signed-in account, a scanned PDF or a document photo
S43.04.note: The File row appears only when the app is in Cloud mode. The PDF is recognised by mime type in AttachmentPreview.tsx; I did not confirm the file picker's accepted types.
steps: Make sure Cloud is selected, then tap Add to chat and tap File.
Pick a scanned PDF or a photo of a document.
Type 'Read this document and explain it' in Message input and tap Send message.
Check that the reply reads and explains the document, as Expected says.
S43.04.where: Chat screen > Add to chat > File (Cloud mode only) or Photos

S43.05.needs: a signed-in account, a chart image file
S43.05.note: No chart-specific control exists; this is a normal photo attachment. Owner's live check of the upload scanner is still pending.
steps: Tap Add to chat, then Photos, and pick a chart image.
Type 'What trends does this chart show? Give the main values.' in Message input and tap Send message.
Check that the reply names the data and the trend, as Expected says.
S43.05.where: Chat screen > Add to chat > Photos

S43.06.needs: a signed-in account, a diagram image file
S43.06.note: No diagram-specific control exists; this is a normal photo attachment. Owner's live check of the upload scanner is still pending.
steps: Tap Add to chat, then Photos, and pick a diagram image.
Type 'Explain the structure of this diagram.' in Message input and tap Send message.
Check that the reply describes the parts and how they connect, as Expected says.
S43.06.where: Chat screen > Add to chat > Photos

S43.07.needs: a signed-in account, a photo of handwriting
S43.07.note: No handwriting-specific control exists. On-device (Local) mode reads only printed text, so use Cloud. Owner's live check is still pending.
steps: Tap Add to chat, then Photos, and pick a photo of handwritten notes.
Type 'Transcribe these notes.' in Message input and tap Send message.
Check that the reply gives the handwritten text, as Expected says.
S43.07.where: Chat screen > Add to chat > Photos

S43.08.needs: an iPhone with AGI installed, a page with printed text
S43.08.note: No in-app button opens the Scan Text screen; the route is reached only from the scan intent (apps/mobile/app/_layout.tsx). The drawer has a scan entry hidden as FULL_SCREEN. The Copy text pill shows only when text was found. The mobile chat also reads text from attached images on-device in Local mode.
steps: On an iPhone, run the Shortcuts action or Siri phrase Scan with AGI.
On Scan Text, take a photo of a page with printed text.
Tap Copy text and check that the pill changes to Copied.
Paste into a note and check that the text matches Expected.
S43.08.where: Siri or Shortcuts (iPhone): Scan with AGI; then the Scan Text screen > Copy text

S43.12.needs: a signed-in account, an image with several countable objects
S43.12.note: No counting control exists; the count depends on the model's answer. Owner's live check of the upload scanner is still pending.
steps: Tap Add to chat, then Photos, and pick an image with several of the same object (for example apples).
Type 'How many apples are in this picture?' in Message input and tap Send message.
Check that the reply gives a count, as Expected says.
S43.12.where: Chat screen > Add to chat > Photos

S43.13.needs: a signed-in account, two scene photos
S43.13.note: No scene-comparison control exists; this is the same as S43.02 with a comparison prompt. Owner's live check of the upload scanner is still pending.
steps: Tap Add to chat, then Photos, and select two different scene photos (selection keeps the order you tap).
Type 'Describe the differences between the first and second photo.' in Message input and tap Send message.
Check that the reply names the differences between the two scenes, as Expected says.
S43.13.where: Chat screen > Add to chat > Photos

S43.14.needs: a signed-in account, a device or error to photograph
S43.14.note: The Camera row appears only when the camera capability is allowed. No troubleshooting-specific control exists. Owner's live check of the upload scanner is still pending.
steps: Tap Add to chat, then Camera, and take a photo of the device or error screen (or choose one with Photos).
Type 'My router shows this light. What should I check?' in Message input and tap Send message.
Check that the reply gives troubleshooting steps, as Expected says.
S43.14.where: Chat screen > Add to chat > Camera (or Photos)

S43.17.needs: a signed-in account, an image to use as reference, an image-capable model
S43.17.note: 'Change this image' shows only in Cloud mode for signed-in users on a model that edits images. The reference logic is in apps/mobile/src/features/chat/actions/resolveMobileImageGenerationRequest.ts (resolveReferenceImage); the quoted line from the audit is gone, but the feature is still there. I did not check how tapping a generated image opens it full screen.
steps: Tap Add to chat, then Create image (the chat switches to image generation).
Tap Attach from Library or Photos and pick an image; up to 4 photos can be attached, and the first is edited.
Type 'Make the sky sunset orange' in Message input and tap Send message.
Check that the new image is based on the chosen reference, as Expected says.
Optional: tap a generated image in the chat, tap Change this image, type in Describe the change, then tap Change the image.
S43.17.where: Chat screen > Add to chat > Create image > Attach from Library (or Photos); or open a generated image > Change this image
